name: customer-360-reinvented
description: Customer 360 Reinvented — an Accenture accelerator: a relationship-level commercial-credit cockpit for C&I bankers. Reads the customer/obligor group live from Salesforce (nCino + FSC) via the org-hosted Customer360 MCP server (7 read tools, per-user OAuth) plus Boom-spread financials, then renders an interactive Cowork artifact — ownership graph, exposure & collateral, covenants, whitespace, and structural early-warning signals — with an 'Explain this' AI panel. Use when a banker asks to open the Customer 360, pull up the relationship view, or answer an account-level portfolio question.
